parameters.query:
SELECT 
  da.source_keyword,
  COUNT(*) AS keyword_count,
  MIN(FROM_UNIXTIME(da.create_time)) AS first_time,
  MAX(FROM_UNIXTIME(da.create_time)) AS last_time
FROM douyin_aweme da
WHERE da.source_keyword IS NOT NULL
  AND da.source_keyword != ''
GROUP BY da.source_keyword
ORDER BY keyword_count DESC, da.source_keyword ASC;
